title: Trustworthy and Fair SkinGPT-R1 for Democratizing Dermatological Reasoning across Diverse Ethnicities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating diagnostic accuracy and Worst-Group Performance (WGP) across different Fitzpatrick skin types (I-VI) using phenotypically stratified datasets like Fitz17k and DDI to measure algorithmic performance disparities between lighter and darker skin tones.
